name: ENEST
recent: Enest Group Berhad 近期签署谅解备忘录，独家供应沙巴 Gomantong 燕窝；同时公布 2026 财年第三季度业绩，营收同比大增 113.1%，但因 IPO 费用录得净亏损 179 万令吉。首席财务官在闭市期间多次增持公司股份。
notable: 子公司签署谅解备忘录，独家供应沙巴 Gomantong 燕窝。
公布 2026 财年第三季度业绩，营收同比增 113.1%，净亏损 179 万令吉，主要因 IPO 费用。
首席财务官在闭市期间多次增持公司股份。
risks: 季度净亏损 179 万令吉，主要因 IPO 费用。
营收环比下降 13.6%，净利环比下降 40.7%。
earnings: 2026 财年第三季度营收 3639 万令吉，环比下降 13.6%；净利 120.7 万令吉，环比下降 40.7%，净利率从 4.8% 降至 3.3%。

recent_en: Enest Group Berhad recently signed an MoU for exclusive supply of bird's nests from Sabah's Gomantong caves. It also reported Q3 FY2026 results with revenue up 113.1% year-on-year but a net loss of RM1.79 million due to IPO expenses. The CFO acquired shares multiple times during the closed period.
notable_en: A subsidiary signed an MoU for exclusive supply of bird's nests from Sabah's Gomantong caves.
Reported Q3 FY2026 results with revenue up 113.1% year-on-year and a net loss of RM1.79 million, mainly due to IPO expenses.
The CFO acquired shares multiple times during the closed period.
risks_en: Quarterly net loss of RM1.79 million, mainly due to IPO expenses.
Revenue declined 13.6% quarter-on-quarter and net profit fell 40.7% quarter-on-quarter.
earnings_en: Q3 FY2026 revenue was RM36.39 million, down 13.6% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was RM1.207 million, down 40.7% quarter-on-quarter, with net margin falling from 4.8% to 3.3%.
